name: Shirahama Miyuki
source:
Childhood friend. She is the only daughter of the neighbour.
She loves Satoru and tries to spend as much time as possible with him, but since she has a weak will, it's difficult for her to do it. She does not have enough courage to confess because she feels inferior compared to his family.

[spoiler]She gets raped by some delinquents. After they get bored of her, she is forced into prostitution and gets pregnant.[/spoiler]
